actions.create_company_update.descriptio: Post on a LinkedIn Company Page you manage
actions.create_company_update.props.comp: Only pages where your account can post are listed.
Posts to a Company Page are always public.
actions.create_company_update.props.imag: With a Link URL, the image becomes the link's thumbnail.
actions.create_company_update.props.link: Title and description show only when a Link URL is set.
actions.create_company_update.props.text: Up to 3,000 characters of plain text; an @ does not tag anyone.
actions.create_image_upload_url.descript: Reserve a LinkedIn image URN and a URL to upload the bytes to
actions.create_image_upload_url.props.ow: Who will own the image. Defaults to the connected member.
actions.create_member_post.description: Publish a post on the connected LinkedIn member's personal profile
actions.create_member_post.props.image_u: URN of an image already uploaded to LinkedIn, for example urn:li:image:D4E10AQ.... Obtain it from Create Image Upload URL and PUT the bytes to that upload URL before posting.
actions.create_member_post.props.link.de: Optional URL to attach as an article preview.
actions.create_share_update.description: Post on your personal LinkedIn profile
actions.create_share_update.props.imageU: With a Link URL, the image becomes the link's thumbnail.
actions.create_share_update.props.link_p: Title and description show only when a Link URL is set.
actions.create_share_update.props.text.d: Up to 3,000 characters of plain text; an @ does not tag anyone.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Calls to /rest/ need LinkedIn-Version: 202511 and X-Restli-Protocol-Version: 2.0.0. Authorization comes from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.delete_post.description: Permanently delete a LinkedIn post by its URN
actions.delete_post.props.post_urn.descr: URN of the post to delete, for example urn:li:share:7212345678901234567.
actions.get_current_member_profile.descr: Get the profile of the LinkedIn member who owns the connection
actions.list_managed_organizations.descr: List the LinkedIn organization pages the connected member administers
actions.update_post_commentary.descripti: Edit the commentary, call-to-action label or landing page of an existing LinkedIn post
actions.update_post_commentary.props.com: New body text. Leave empty to keep the current text.
actions.update_post_commentary.props.con: New call-to-action button label. Leave empty to keep the current one.
New destination for the call-to-action button. Leave empty to keep the current one.
actions.update_post_commentary.props.pos: URN of the post to edit, for example urn:li:share:7212345678901234567.
auth.description: Sign in with the LinkedIn account that should publish the posts. To post on a Company Page, that account must be one of its admins.
description: Post to LinkedIn profiles and Company Pages
